title: Nutty Crispy Polish Potato Fritters
description: A festive Polish dish featuring caramelized onions, crispy exterior, and nutty flavor. Perfect for a high-protein snack or side dish.
instructions: Grate the potatoes and onions coarsely.
Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat. Add grated onions and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15-20 minutes, or until caramelized.
Mix together grated potatoes, cooked onions, beaten egg, Greek yogurt, chopped parsley, salt, black pepper, and chopped walnuts in a bowl.
Add gluten-free flour and breadcrumbs to the potato mixture and mix until well combined.
Heat tadka in a small pan over low heat. Carefully add 2 cups of water and bring to a simmer.
Using a spoon, add small portions of the potato mixture to the tadka water and fry until golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the tadka water and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Fry the remaining potato mixture in batches until all the fritters are cooked.
Serve the nutty crispy Polish potato fritters hot, garnished with chopped parsley and a drizzle of tadka.
